2. We believe the stakes are clear: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. The world needs serious action now to prevent that outcome.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will leave most countries unable to defend themselves. We cannot wait for that danger to arrive before acting. We need a global response that matches the scale of the threat.

### Newsletter opening

We face a stark security challenge. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. That is not a distant concern to set aside for another day; it is a defining risk of our time. We believe the scale and speed of this change could overwhelm the safeguards nations rely on to protect their people and preserve their independence. The choices made now will shape whether countries can continue to keep themselves safe. We must bring this danger into the open, take it seriously, and build a global response before the world’s defenses are outmatched.
